name: JPM-07: The same member re-joins at One-Time and is charged $10 + $3

steps.name: MEMBER: re-priced group is discoverable on Explore
Wait for selector getByPlaceholder('Search for groups names or leaders')
Clear getByPlaceholder('Search for groups names or leaders')
Fill "PW_Group_20260827_112801_w3r02461vy" getByPlaceholder('Search for groups names or leaders')
Expect "toHaveValue" getByPlaceholder('Search for groups names or leaders')
Group card "PW_Group_20260827_112801_w3r02461vy" should be visible getByTestId('explore-group-card').filter({ hasText: 'PW_Group_20260827_112801_w3r02461vy' }).first()
Wait for selector getByTestId('explore-group-card').filter({ hasText: 'PW_Group_20260827_112801_w3r02461vy' }).first().getByText('PW_Group_20260827_112801_w3r02461vy', { exact: true }).first()

Group name "PW_Group_20260827_112801_w3r02461vy" should appear inside the card getByTestId('explore-group-card').filter({ hasText: 'PW_Group_20260827_112801_w3r02461vy' }).first().getByText('PW_Group_20260827_112801_w3r02461vy', { exact: true }).first()
MEMBER: side panel shows 10 One time - the leader's price reaches the member
Side panel should show "$10 One time" for group "PW_Group_20260827_112801_w3r02461vy" getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Group Details' }).getByText('$10 One time', { exact: true }).first()
The join CTA should read "Join Group" on a group priced One-Time 10. It read "Join Group". The label does not vary by pricing model — if it now does, the product changed.
A group priced One-Time 10 should show "10" beside its join CTA. The member saw "$10 One time" — the leader's pricing is not reaching them.
MEMBER: One-Time side panel discloses the $3 fee (reported)
Side panel should offer the "Show platform fee details" affordance beside the price getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Group Details' }).getByLabel('Show platform fee details').first()
Hover getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Group Details' }).getByLabel('Show platform fee details').first()

Hovering "Show platform fee details" should reveal the platform fee notice ("+3$ platform fee will be added to your total") — the member has no other way to learn the price is not final getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Group Details' }).getByText('+3$ platform fee will be added to your total', { exact: true }).first()
MEMBER: One-Time checkout charges price + $3, then pays
